title: Africville Museum

services.name: Walking Africville Audio Tour
services.desc: For a truly evocative journey, we invite you to explore this interactive walking tour. This experience pairs archival photography from the 1960s with the living memories of those who called Africville home. Hear personal stories and memories tied to specific landmarks: - The Lookoff & The Tracks: Relive the sights and sounds of the community’s edge. - The Church: Hear the heart of the community beating through the voices of former residents. - The Water’s Edge: Connect with the natural landscape that defined daily life. services.name: Africville Sailing School
services.desc: This August, the Africville Sailing School made waves - literally and figuratively - as young participants took to the waters of the Bedford Basin. In partnership with Sail Nova Scotia and WeCANFoil, the program welcomed African Nova Scotian and Indigenous youth for hands-on sailing lessons, races, and waterfront fun. The school offers a fresh way to connect with the ocean, build confidence, and explore new possibilities.
